hooks.description: Run the Node test suite whenever a library or app file changes, so a broken pure function never survives a save.
hooks.name: test-on-lib-change
hooks.onFailure: Show the failing test output and stop — do not continue editing until tests are green.

hooks.description: Remind the agent that no new feature lands without a requirement id and a tasks.md checkbox.
hooks.name: spec-guard

run.command: echo 'spec-guard: confirm the change maps to a requirement in .kiro/specs/deadlink/requirements.md'
